author: Anna Dewdney

hero.name: Llama Llama
hero.description: Young llama character, main protagonist of the Llama Llama series by Anna Dewdney
hero.source_note: Activity images already contains llama_llama — use that existing icon

notes: This board covers the core Llama Llama Red Pyjama story about bedtime anxiety and waiting for mama. All 11 fringe words already exist in the activity_images folder, so no new sourcing is required. The hero icon llama_llama is also already available. The series has multiple titles; this board is best suited to Llama Llama Red Pyjama but is broadly applicable across the series. Words like 'fret', 'tantrum', and 'stuffed_llama' are available in activity_images as bonus icons but were not selected as the 11 chosen words best cover the key communicative functions for SPED students (emotions, characters, objects, actions).
